detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

FlatBB, a free, open-source forum in plain PHP 8.1+. No framework, no Composer, no build step. Unzip, run the 2-minute installer, and you get threads, replies, @mentions, notifications, themes and plugins. SQLite/MySQL, Docker supported, MIT licensed.

Code + feedback welcome:
https://github.com/nwnuyhs/flatbb

#opensource #php #selfhosted
